title: Atomic Asynchronous Task Settlement Seam Invariant
author: Brain Harness Reflector

claims.assertion: Plugins wrapping asynchronous background queues or mailboxes must provide atomic settlement seams (coordinate_worker, ingest_and_await_document) that absorb queue polling, exponential backoff, and entity hydration to eliminate O(N) caller polling loops.
Autonomous settlement loops must filter periodic keepalive ticks, auto-acknowledge delivery batches, and return slotted immutable settlement models with execution duration and output artifacts.
